text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I didn't mean to make you worry. I'm
fine. It's
nothing, really.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I just feel like I've been getting tired
more easily
lately...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's not your fault though! I've
probably just
been pushing myself a tad
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Super Creek is smiling,
something is
very clearly wrong. I should
make some
adjustments to her race
schedule.
